"""Read-only V24 evidence audit; no operator application or field solve."""
from pathlib import Path
from copy import deepcopy
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import csv
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import numpy as np
from benchmarks.check_task042_local_block_records import check, complete

ROOT=Path.cwd(); R=ROOT/'docs/task042_neural_coarse_inverse/outcomes/records'
HEAD='31ad54a9d774f384aa11699da8c14befbdc3b6e2'
PREV='0e0a9f49ae0310cd9b219d39f059f97f8a86bfa3'
def read(p): return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def sha(data): return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def rows(p): return list(csv.DictReader(Path(p).open()))
def ah(a): return sha(np.ascontiguousarray(a).tobytes())
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()==HEAD
old=read(R/'independent_review_v21_20261002.json')
changed_old=[]
for item in old['task_inventory']['files']:
    if sha(Path(item['path']).read_bytes())!=item['sha256']: changed_old.append(item['path'])
assert set(changed_old)=={f'docs/task042_neural_coarse_inverse/{p}' for p in ['README.md','review_report_v21.md','outcomes/summary.md','outcomes/test_summary.md','outcomes/changed_files.md']}
changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',PREV,HEAD],text=True).splitlines()
inventory=[dict(path=p,sha256=sha(Path(p).read_bytes()),bytes=Path(p).stat().st_size) for p in changed]
bound_files=[]; stages=[]; raw={}
for run in read(R/'run_index_v24.json')['runs']:
    for name,item in dict(stage_result=run['result'],**run['files']).items():
        data=Path(item['path']).read_bytes()
        assert sha(data)==item['sha256'],(run['stage'],name)
        bound_files.append(dict(item,stage=run['stage'],name=name,bytes=len(data)))
    result=read(run['result']['path']); raw[run['stage']]=result
    summary=read(run['files']['run_summary.json']['path'])
    assert Path(run['files']['source_sha.txt']['path']).read_text().strip()==run['source_sha']=='03fd7874190c33a837879d76312d9911223314e0'
    assert summary['classification']=='COMPLETED' and summary['descendants_cleared'] and summary['leader_exit_code']==0
    end=summary['clock_end']['utc_ns']/1e9
    assert end<datetime(2026,10,2,15,34,23,502588,tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp()
    stages.append(dict(stage=run['stage'],source=run['source_sha'],status=result['status'],
        reference_read=result['reference_arrays_read'],end_utc=datetime.fromtimestamp(end,timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        supervised_wall=summary.get('elapsed_seconds'),launch_wall=summary['launch_wall_seconds'],
        tree_peak=summary['sampled_process_tree_rss_peak_bytes'],swap=summary['sampled_process_tree_swap_peak_bytes']))

states=[]
for name in ('LW','LCW','LZ','LCZ'):
    result=raw[name]
    assert len(result['cycles'])==4 and result['first_pass_cycle'] is None
    for cycle in result['cycles']:
        item=cycle['state'];data=Path(item['path']).read_bytes();assert sha(data)==item['sha256']
        with np.load(item['path'],allow_pickle=False) as f:
            for member in f.files: assert ah(f[member])==item[member+'_sha256'],(name,member)
            assert np.array_equal(f['z'][:18144],f['trace']) and np.array_equal(f['z'][18144:],f['port'])
            states.append(dict(route=name,cycle=cycle['cycle'],path=item['path'],sha256=item['sha256'],
                member_hashes_pass=True,bytes=len(data),trace_residual_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(f['residual'][:18144])),
                full_residual_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(f['residual'])),rho=cycle['audit']['schur_relative']))
cost=read(R/'resource_costs_v24.json')
assert abs(sum(r['supervised_wall'] for r in stages)-cost['formal_supervised_wall_seconds'])<1e-8
assert abs(sum(r['launch_wall'] for r in stages)-cost['formal_launch_wall_seconds'])<1e-8
for item in cost['outer_supervision']+cost['auxiliary_runs']:
    data=Path(item['file']['path']).read_bytes();assert sha(data)==item['file']['sha256']
    summary=json.loads(data);assert summary['sampled_process_tree_rss_peak_bytes']==item['RSS_peak_bytes']
assert max([r['tree_peak'] for r in stages]+[i['RSS_peak_bytes'] for i in cost['outer_supervision']+cost['auxiliary_runs']])==cost['simultaneous_sampled_tree_peak_bytes']
source=read(R/'source_inventory_v24.json')
for item in [source['collector'],source['helpers'],*source['orchestration']]:assert sha(Path(item['path']).read_bytes())==item['sha256']

power=rows(R/'per_channel_power_v24.csv');candidates=rows(R/'candidate_comparison_v24.csv')
fields=read(R/'field_checks_v24.json')
field_keys={'full_FE_L2_relative','full_FE_scaled_curl_relative','scattered_FE_L2_relative','scattered_scaled_curl_relative','selected_E_relative','selected_H_relative'}
power_keys={'R_total','T_total','A_balance','A_volume'}
maxima=[]
for row in candidates:
    f=fields['rows'][row['state']]
    assert set(f['fields'])==field_keys and set(f['comparison']['power_absolute_differences'])==power_keys
    p=[i for i in power if i['state']==row['state']]
    assert len(p)==40 and len({(i['side'],i['m'],i['n'],i['polarization']) for i in p})==40
    worst=max(p,key=lambda i:abs(float(i['power'])-float(i['reference_power'])))
    delta=abs(float(worst['power'])-float(worst['reference_power']))
    assert abs(delta-float(row['max_channel_power_difference']))<1e-14
    maxima.append(dict(state=row['state'],delta=delta,side=worst['side'],m=worst['m'],n=worst['n'],polarization=worst['polarization'],reference_plane_z=worst['reference_plane_z']))

probes={}
valid=deepcopy(fields['rows']['LW-FINAL'])
valid['audit']['schur_relative']=5e-7
valid['comparison']['max_channel_power_difference']=5e-7
assert complete(valid,True)
for label in ('missing_selected_H','empty_fields','missing_A_volume','empty_powers'):
    obj=deepcopy(valid)
    if label=='missing_selected_H':del obj['fields']['selected_H_relative']
    elif label=='empty_fields':obj['fields']={}
    elif label=='missing_A_volume':del obj['comparison']['power_absolute_differences']['A_volume']
    else:obj['comparison']['power_absolute_differences']={}
    probes[label]=dict(observed_complete=complete(obj,True),expected_complete=False)
    assert probes[label]['observed_complete']

coverage=read(R/'frozen_residual_image_coverage_v24.json')['rows']
derived={}
for name in ('LW','LZ'):
    c=coverage[name];state=next(s for s in states if s['route']==name and s['cycle']==4)
    assert abs(state['trace_residual_norm']-c['final_original_trace_residual_norm'])<1e-16
    factor=np.sqrt(1-c['residual_squared_fraction_in_U'])
    assert abs(factor-c['predicted_one_J_residual_norm_ratio'])<1e-15
    derived[name]=dict(squared_fraction=c['residual_squared_fraction_in_U'],norm_reduction_fraction=float(1-factor),
                      predicted_rho_after_one_J=float(state['rho']*factor),not_executed=True)
cycle_rows=rows(R/'cycle_history_v24.csv')
progress={}
for name in ('LW','LCW','LZ','LCZ'):
    c=[r for r in cycle_rows if r['route']==name]
    start=raw[name]['start']['original_equation_gate']['rho']
    progress[name]=dict(initial_rho=start,final_rho=float(c[-1]['rho']),
      first4_reduction=1-float(c[-1]['rho'])/start,last_cycle_reduction=1-float(c[-1]['rho'])/float(c[-2]['rho']))

out=dict(schema_version=1,review_date_utc8='2026-10-03',reviewed_remote_HEAD=HEAD,previous_review=PREV,
 previous_inventory_sha256=sha((R/'independent_review_v21_20261002.json').read_bytes()),
 scope='incremental semantic review and read-only raw checks; no new operator apply, PDE, NN training, factorization or full repository audit',
 task042_actor_observed=False,host_observation_utc='2026-10-02T22:27Z',
 historical_inventory_changed_only=changed_old,changed_files=inventory,
 checker=check(R),targeted_tests=dict(command='python -m pytest -q src/test/test_task042_v24_admission.py src/test/test_task042_v24_compact_qualification.py',passed=16,pytest_seconds=.37,mode='qualified native pure, numpy1.26.4/scipy1.11.4, math1'),
 raw_bound_files=bound_files,raw_bound_bytes=sum(i['bytes'] for i in bound_files),stages=stages,cycle_arrays=states,
 cycle_arrays_bytes=sum(s['bytes'] for s in states),power_maxima=maxima,raw_required_field_inventories='all five present',
 checker_missing_inventory_probes=probes,probe_scope='synthetic scalar mutations in memory only; raw records unchanged',
 derived_existing_image_predictions=derived,progress=progress,
 cost=dict(formal_supervised_wall=cost['formal_supervised_wall_seconds'],formal_launch_wall=cost['formal_launch_wall_seconds'],
           tree_peak=cost['simultaneous_sampled_tree_peak_bytes'],charged=cost['charged'],
           factor_seconds=sum(x['factor_seconds'] for x in cost['factor_safety']),gecon_seconds=sum(x['gecon_seconds'] for x in cost['factor_safety']),
           factor_only_trace_upper_at_2TB_balanced_8=float(np.sqrt(2e12/4))),
 unchecked=['FE fields not recomputed from quadrature','large matrix/LU/U payload hashes not all re-read','no full GitHub visual','no CI, MPI or full pytest'],
 reviewer_script_sha256=sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),reviewer_helper_repair='First metadata-only attempt raised duplicate bytes keyword TypeError; fixed dict merge, no solver/operator ran or raw data changed.')
dest=Path('/tmp/task042_review22_evidence.json');dest.write_text(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:out[k] for k in ['checker','raw_bound_bytes','cycle_arrays_bytes','power_maxima','checker_missing_inventory_probes','derived_existing_image_predictions','progress','cost']},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
